degree_required.quote: Verification of either a doctoral degree in dentistry from a dental program accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor organization or the educational equivalent of a doctoral degree in dentistry, as determined by the board

required.quote: an applicant for licensure as a dentist must comply with the provisions of section 18341 and must provide: A. Verification of either a doctoral degree in dentistry from a dental program accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor organization or the educational equivalent of a doctoral degree in dentistry, as determined by the board; and B. Verification of passing all examinations required by the board.

experience_source.quote: Verification of either a doctoral degree in dentistry from a dental program accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor organization

exams.name: Board-required examinations
exams.notes: The statute requires passing all examinations required by the board; specific exam names are not stated in the statute but the compact provision references the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations.
exams.quote: Verification of passing all examinations required by the board.

exams.name: National board examination (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.notes: Required for compact privilege; accepted as licensure examination under the compact.
exams.jurisdiction: national (Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations)
exams.quote: Accept the national board examinations of the Joint Commission on National Dental Examinations or another examination accepted by commission rule as a licensure examination

required.quote: As a condition of renewal of a license to practice, an applicant must have a current basic life support certification and complete continuing education during the licensing cycle prior to application for renewal.

value: 3 hours on prescription of opioid medication every 2 years (as condition of prescribing opioid medication)
topical_requirements.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter must successfully complete 3 hours of continuing education every 2 years on the prescription of opioid medication as a condition of prescribing opioid medication.

available.quote: The board is authorized, at its discretion, to waive the examination requirements and issue a license or grant an authority to an applicant who is licensed under the laws of another state, a United States territory, a foreign nation or a foreign administrative division that issues licenses in the dental professions who furnishes proof, satisfactory to the board, that the requirements for licensure under this chapter have been met.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in good standing in another jurisdiction; may qualify by showing either (A) substantially equivalent valid license held for at least 3 consecutive years immediately preceding the application, or (B) qualifications substantially similar to Maine requirements. Board has discretion to waive exam requirements.
requirements.quote: An applicant who is licensed in good standing at the time of application to the board under the laws of another state, a United States territory, a foreign nation or a foreign administrative division that issues licenses in the dental professions may qualify for licensure by submitting evidence to the board that the applicant has held a substantially equivalent, valid license for at least 3 consecutive years immediately preceding the application to the board at the level of licensure applied for in this State.

exists.quote: The Board of Dental Practice, as established in Title 5, section 12004‑A, subsection 10, is created within this subchapter, its sole purpose being to protect the public health and welfare.

national_association.quote: a doctoral degree in dentistry from a dental program accredited by the American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation or its successor organization

credential_type.quote: Only an individual may be licensed under this chapter and only a licensed individual may provide services for which a license is required under this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: a person may not practice or profess to be authorized to practice the activities described in this chapter without a license or during any period when that person's license has expired or has been suspended or revoked.

title_protection.quote: Use the words dentist, dental surgeon or oral surgeon and the letters D.D.S. or D.M.D. and any other words, letters, title or descriptive matter that represents that person as being able to diagnose, treat, prescribe or operate for a disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of the human teeth or jaws or adjacent structures

scope_protection.quote: a person may not practice or profess to be authorized to practice the activities described in this chapter without a license or during any period when that person's license has expired or has been suspended or revoked.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license or in connection with services within the scope of the license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The practice of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining a license or authority from the board or in connection with services within the scope of the license or authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in endangering patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misuse of alcohol, drugs or other substances that has resulted or may result in the licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional diagnosis of mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in endangering patients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A professional diagnosis of a mental or physical condition that has resulted or may result in the licensee performing services in a manner that endangers the health or safety of patients

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed or authorized by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence in the practice for which the licensee is licensed or authorized by the board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a standard of professional behavior established in the practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct. A licensee is considered to have engaged in unprofessional conduct if the licensee violates a standard of professional behavior that has been established in the practice for which the licensee is licensed or authorized by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime involving dishonesty, false statement, or that relates to the practice, or conviction for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a crime that involves dishonesty or false statement or that relates directly to the practice for which the licensee is licensed or authorized by the board, or conviction of a crime for which incarceration for one year or more may be imposed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in false, misleading or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting unlicensed practice by a person not licensed or authorized as required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting unlicensed practice by a person who is not licensed or authorized as required under this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide supervision as required under the chapter or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide supervision as required under this chapter or a rule adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any activity requiring a license that is beyond the scope of acts authorized by the license held
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any activity requiring a license or authority under this chapter or rule adopted by the board that is beyond the scope of acts authorized by the license or authority held

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continuing to act in a capacity requiring a license after expiration, suspension or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continuing to act in a capacity requiring a license or authority under this chapter or a rule adopted by the board after expiration, suspension or revocation of that license or authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Noncompliance with an order of or consent agreement executed by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Noncompliance with an order of or consent agreement executed by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to produce requested documents relevant to a pending complaint or investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to produce any requested documents in the licensee's possession or under the licensee's control relevant to a pending complaint, proceeding or matter under investigation by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: A violation of this chapter or a rule adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A violation of this chapter or a rule adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements of Title 22, section 7253 (opioid-related requirements)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements of Title 22, section 7253

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering botulinum toxins or dermal fillers when not supported by a diagnosed dental condition or patient dental treatment plan
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering botulinum toxins or dermal fillers to a patient when that administration is not supported by a diagnosed dental condition or is not part of a patient's dental treatment plan.

definition_quote.value: "Dentistry" means the scope of practice for a dentist as described in section 18371.
definition_quote.quote: "Dentistry" means the scope of practice for a dentist as described in section 18371.

value: Perform dental operations, oral surgery or dental services
Obtain impressions of human tooth, teeth or jaws
Supply artificial substitutes for natural teeth; furnish, supply, construct, reproduce or repair prosthetic dentures, bridges, appliances
Place dental appliances or structures in the human mouth and adjust
Diagnose, prescribe for and treat disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of human teeth or jaws or adjacent structures
Correct malformations of teeth and jaws
Repair or fill cavities in human teeth
Diagnose malposed teeth and make and adjust appliances or artificial casts
Use x-ray machine and interpret dental x-rays
Prescribe drugs or medicine and administer local anesthesia, analgesia including nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation and, with appropriate permit, administer sedation and general anesthesia
Take case histories and perform physical examinations
Administer botulinum toxin or dermal fillers with diagnosed dental condition or as part of dental treatment plan
methods_authorized.quote: A dentist, faculty dentist, limited dentist or resident dentist may: A. Perform a dental operation or oral surgery or dental service of any kind

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe drugs or medicine and administer local anesthesia, analgesia including nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation. With the appropriate permit issued by the board, may administer sedation and general anesthesia.
drug_authority.quote: Prescribe drugs or medicine and administer local anesthesia, analgesia including nitrous oxide and oxygen inhalation and, with the appropriate permit issued by the board, administer sedation and general anesthesia necessary for proper dental treatment

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: with the appropriate permit issued by the board, administer sedation and general anesthesia necessary for proper dental treatment

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: "Direct supervision" means the supervision required of those tasks and procedures requiring the physical presence of the supervisor in the practice setting at the time such tasks or procedures are being performed. ... "General supervision" means the supervision of those tasks and procedures that do not require the physical presence of the supervisor in the practice setting while procedures are being performed but do require the tasks and procedures to be performed with the prior knowledge and consent of the supervisor.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: For public health dental hygienist authority: A copy of the written agreement between the applicant and a supervising dentist that outlines the roles and responsibilities of the parties

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: "Independent practice dental hygienist" means a person who holds a valid license as a dental hygienist issued by the board and who is authorized to practice independent dental hygiene.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: "Dental therapist" means a person who holds a valid license as a dental hygienist issued by the board and is authorized to practice dental therapy under this chapter.

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist may practice under the general supervision of a dentist through a written practice agreement signed by both parties.

dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist may perform the following procedures in limited practice settings, if authorized by a written practice agreement under the general supervision of a supervising dentist licensed in this State

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: Practice dentistry under the name of a corporation, company, association, parlor or trade name

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: an individual licensed under this chapter whose scope of practice includes prescribing opioid medication may not prescribe: A. To a patient any combination of opioid medication in an aggregate amount in excess of 100 morphine milligram equivalents of opioid medication per day

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A dentist who uses the services of a person not licensed to practice dentistry in this State to construct, alter, repair or duplicate a denture, plate, partial plate, bridge, splint, orthodontic or prosthetic appliance shall first furnish the unlicensed person with a written prescription

teledentistry_authorized.quote: An individual licensed under this chapter may provide oral health care services and procedures authorized under this chapter or by rule using teledentistry.

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: For local anesthesia authority: (1) Verification of having successfully completed a course of study required by board rule; and (2) Verification of passing all examinations required by board rule

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: For nitrous oxide analgesia authority: (1) Verification of having successfully completed a course of study required by board rule; and (2) Verification of passing all examinations required by board rule

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The dentist shall retain for 2 years a duplicate copy of all prescriptions issued pursuant to this subsection for inspection by the board.

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: An applicant seeking an initial or a renewed license must include evidence of basic life support certification.

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: "Independent practice dental hygienist" means a person who holds a valid license as a dental hygienist issued by the board and who is authorized to practice independent dental hygiene.
